Zoey M.: Quick coordination for candidate (Salim Rahman) coming next Monday. International candidate, arriving from YYZ, flight lands 08:50. He asked if we can ship a loaner ahead instead of using a desk loaner.
Tariq A.: Shipping OK if we have confirmed delivery address and someone to sign. Do we have a spare MacBook with company image?
People Ops: We can ship but prefer pick-up at reception to avoid lost packages. He'll stay at a partner hotel; we can ship to reception and hold for him. Also confirm visa status — HR says he has ESTA and expects no border issues.
IT Support: Loaner inventory shows MAC-LOAN-07 (MacBook Air) available. Can image and create local user. Shipping ETA 2 business days. Will need recipient name and arrival date.
Front Desk: We can sign for packages Monday morning and hold at reception. Please include "Hold for: Salim Rahman" on shipping label. Reception hours 08:00-18:00.
Travel Team: Hotel booked (Partner Inn, voucher attached). We also reserved airport transfer for 09:15 pickup to office if he prefers that instead of coming directly to reception.
Zoey M.: Let's ship to reception with hold note. ETA must be Sat to ensure it's there. Also he needs an HDMI adapter and a USB-C ethernet dongle. Can IT include those in the box?
IT Support: We can include adapters. Shipping checklist: loaner, power, HDMI adapter, USB-C ethernet, charger, printed agenda, NDA paper copy. Will mark device with tag SALIM-2009.
People Ops: Note: Candidate requested childcare reimbursement for interview day (has infant). Our policy covers up to $75 with receipt — will include instructions in candidate email. Also requested a quiet lactation room — reserved Room L2 near 4th floor.
Tariq A.: I'll be the on-site host until 3pm. Can someone add "Meet Host: Tariq A." in the calendar invite and tell reception to page me on arrival?
Front Desk: Added "Meet Host: Tariq A." to check-in script and will page him.
Zoey M.: One more: Salim asked about timezone in calendar — put PST and local arrival time. He also asked whether he can run a small local server during whiteboard task; IT, is that allowed on loaner?
IT Support: For security, no external servers. We can provide a pre-built VM container with repo and local server already running offline. That should cover the exercise.
People Ops: Shipping label created, carrier: LocalCourier, tracking: LC123456789 (will DM). Hotel + transfer confirmed. Lactation room reserved. Childcare reimbursement instructions drafted. NDA copy printed.
IT Support: Device imaged, adapters included, tag SALIM-2009. Shipment scheduled for Fri morning (2-day ground).
Travel Team: Pickup will be Marco Ruiz (driver) at arrivals if he opts for transfer. We'll confirm pickup once flight clears customs.
Zoey M.: Thanks all. I'll send candidate final confirmation with shipping/tracking, check-in steps, laptop instructions, and reimbursement details. Ping here when package is received at reception. :white_check_mark:
